Olczak Group · Berkeley, CA · Full time, in office and on site · $135,000 to $165,000 salary
You are a licensed architect who got tired of handing drawings to someone else to build. Here you design the work, price it, build it, and keep the client, with your name on all of it. This seat is in line for Principal.
We are a licensed architecture practice and a licensed general contractor under one roof, with our own build team. Our work is high end residential in the Bay Area: ground up new homes, gut renovations, and remodels, with budgets that run into the millions. See our work at olczakgroup.com and olczakbuild.com.
What you will own
The work. You lead projects the firm brings in as well as projects you bring in yourself. You are not expected to source all of your own work, and you share in the profit on what you do bring in.
Your projects, start to finish: design from concept through construction documents, the budget at every phase, permitting, and construction through closeout.
The client relationship, from the first meeting to the final walkthrough and the referral after it.
The numbers. We measure schedule against milestones, final cost against the original budget, and drawing errors found in the field, which should trend down.
The people coming up behind you. You sign off at fixed gates on projects led by our Designer Builders and designers, and you mentor them toward licensure.
The firm's standards. You improve how we estimate, draw, and build, and you represent the firm in public.
Who this fits
You hold a current California architect license.
You hold a professional degree in architecture (B.Arch or M.Arch).
You have eight or more years of experience, including real time running construction: budgets, subcontractors, and schedule.
You have taken custom residential projects from concept through completion, and you can speak to cost and schedule in numbers.
You have brought in work of your own.
You are fluent in Revit and Bluebeam.
You can tell a client or a subcontractor something they do not want to hear, and keep the relationship.
A project management certification is welcome and not required.
We are looking for someone professional and proactive, who finishes what they start without being chased and raises a problem early with a fix in hand. Nobody here will manage your day. If you want to design and let someone else carry cost, schedule, and the client, this is the wrong seat.
What you get
Authorship. The project is yours from the first conversation to the punch list.
A path to Principal. Project Leads who excel move into Project Strategist and Principal roles.
$135,000 to $165,000 salary.
A percentage of the profit on work you bring into the company.
A team to lead: designers, coordinators, and an in-house build team.
A working operating system. We have written standards for estimating, bidding, and drawing review, so you are not inventing process on every job.
PTO on accrual basis (per hour worked) for a maximum of 10 days per calendar year @ 40 hrs / week.
Opportunities for continuing education in building science, architecture, materials, and detailing
A positive work culture grounded in mutual respect, accountability, and integrity
Employer subsidized healthcare benefits
How to apply
Send the following to [email protected]:
1.Your resume and portfolio.
2.Your California license number.
3.One page on a single project where you owned cost and schedule. Give us the budget and where it landed, the schedule and where it landed, and the one decision you would make differently.
No cover letter needed. Finalists provide two references who supervised their work directly. We are hiring for a January or February start.
Olczak Group is an equal opportunity employer.
